title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Scheduling Financial Reports via Email (Send Regular Financial Reports to Your Inbox) – No Customization
summary: Business Central 2026 Wave 1 (BC28) introduces scheduled distribution of financial reports via email. Users can set up recurring financial report schedules with multiple recipients, custom filters, and automatic email delivery, eliminating the need for customization.
key_points: Financial reports can now be scheduled for recurring distribution to multiple recipients via email and report inbox
Schedule configuration includes export format (PDF, Excel, Word), recipients, recurrence rules, and custom filters
Scheduled reports are processed by job queue at specified times and automatically distributed to recipient inboxes
User email addresses must be configured in User Setup; custom date filters support dynamic date ranges
This capability was unavailable in BC27.5 and earlier versions

quotes.text: Historically, Financial Reports in BC has lacked support for scheduling when generating or printing reports. But that has finally changed.
quotes.why_it_matters: Highlights the significance of this release as addressing a long-standing gap in the product.
